newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade in Kansas was active Tuesday, with slaughter steers and heifers steady with last mid-week, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand moderate.
Sales confirmed on 34,900 slaughter steers and 24,500 slaughter heifers Tuesday.
For the week to date 73,600 head confirmed including 13,000 head or about 18 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter steers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1350 lbs 72.00, few Brahma cross 71.50; few early 71.00; few Select with end Choice 71.00.

Slaughter heifers Select and Choice 2-3 975-1200 lbs pen 1300 lbs bulk 1050-1100 lbs 72.00, few early 71.00; few Select with end Choice including Brahma cross 71.00-71.50; mixed Commercial to Choice 1075-1230 lb heifers and heiferettes 70.00.
week to date: 73600 last week: 11600 last year: 13400
